license_required.quote: No person shall practice optometry within the meaning of this chapter without a license to do so and a valid certificate of registration issued by the examining board

issuing_authority.quote: In this chapter, "examining board" means optometry examining board.

name.quote: In this chapter, "examining board" means optometry examining board.

type.quote: In this chapter, "examining board" means optometry examining board.

moral_character_required.quote: The person presents proof satisfactory to the examining board that, subject to ss. 111.321, 111.322, and 111.335, he or she does not have an arrest or conviction record.

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited college of optometry
degree_required.quote: The person has graduated from an accredited college of optometry approved and recognized by the examining board.

accrediting_body.quote: accredited college of optometry approved and recognized by the examining board

exams.name: Optometry licensure examination
exams.notes: Must reasonably relate to skills needed to practice optometry; tests general and ocular pharmacology, foreign body removal, and state laws/rules
exams.quote: The person passes an examination approved or conducted by the examining board.

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO) examination
exams.notes: Board may approve in whole or in part an examination prepared by NBEO or another approved provider
exams.quote: Approve in whole or in part an examination prepared, administered, and graded by the national board of examiners in optometry or another examination provider approved by the examining board.

exams.name: Endorsement law examination
exams.notes: Required for licensure by endorsement; tests knowledge of state and federal laws and administrative rules
exams.quote: The person passes an examination that tests knowledge of state and federal laws and administrative rules and regulations regarding the practice of optometry.

exams.name: Topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents examination
exams.notes: Required only for optometrists licensed before August 1, 2006 seeking certification to use diagnostic pharmaceuticals
exams.quote: The examining board may issue certificates under par. (a) only to optometrists who successfully complete an examination approved or conducted by the examining board on the subject of general and ocular pharmacology as it relates to optometry with particular emphasis on the use of topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents

exams.name: Therapeutic pharmaceutical agents examination
exams.notes: Required only for optometrists licensed before August 1, 2006 seeking certification to use therapeutic pharmaceuticals and remove foreign bodies
exams.quote: The optometrist has passed an examination conducted or approved by the examining board.

interval_years.quote: complete, during the 2-year period immediately preceding the renewal date specified in s. 440.08 (2) (a), not less than 30 hours of continuing education

required.quote: The examining board shall promulgate rules requiring a person who is issued a license to practice optometry to complete, during the 2-year period immediately preceding the renewal date specified in s. 440.08 (2) (a), not less than 30 hours of continuing education.

hours_per_period.quote: not less than 30 hours of continuing education

period_years.quote: during the 2-year period immediately preceding the renewal date

value: Requirements that apply only to optometrists who are allowed to use topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents under s. 449.17

topical_requirements.quote: The rules shall include requirements that apply only to optometrists who are allowed to use topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents under s. 449.17 or who are allowed to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents or remove foreign bodies from an eye or from an appendage to the eye under s. 449.18.

available.quote: The examining board may issue a license and certificate of registration to a person who is licensed in good standing to practice optometry in another state that has substantially similar requirements

requirements.value: Must be licensed in good standing in a state with substantially similar requirements; pass examinations in pathology, practical optometry, and state/federal law; pay fee; show 5 years of actual practice; satisfy no-arrest-record and education requirements; and complete required pharmacology study and examinations.
requirements.quote: The person submits satisfactory evidence that the person has actually practiced in the other state for 5 years.

definition_quote.value: The employment of any optometric means, including topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents under s. 449.17, to determine the visual efficiency of the human visual system, including refractive and functional abilities, or to diagnose the presence of ocular disease or ocular manifestations of systemic disease and other departures from normal.
definition_quote.quote: The employment of any optometric means, including topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents under s. 449.17, to determine the visual efficiency of the human visual system, including refractive and functional abilities, or to diagnose the presence of ocular disease or ocular manifestations of systemic disease and other departures from normal.

value: Prescribing, furnishing, fitting or employing ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, frames, aids or prosthetic materials
Administering visual training, orthoptics, visual therapy or any other optometric means
Prescribing or administering drugs for ocular therapeutic purposes
Dispensing contact lenses that deliver a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent
Removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye or an appendage to the eye
Examining into the fact, condition or cause of ocular health or disease
Applying principles or techniques of optometric sciences in the diagnosis, prevention or treatment of a condition or cause of ocular health or disease
methods_authorized.quote: Prescribing, furnishing, fitting or employing ophthalmic lenses, contact lenses, frames, aids or prosthetic materials. b. Administering visual training, orthoptics, visual therapy or any other optometric means. c. Prescribing or administering drugs for ocular therapeutic purposes, dispensing contact lenses that deliver a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent under s. 449.18 (6) (am) 2. b., or removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye or an appendage to the eye under s. 449.18.

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may prescribe or administer drugs for ocular therapeutic purposes and use topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents, subject to certification requirements and rules promulgated by the secretary after consultation with the examining board, medical examining board, and pharmacy examining board.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing or administering drugs for ocular therapeutic purposes, dispensing contact lenses that deliver a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent under s. 449.18 (6) (am) 2. b., or removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye or an appendage to the eye under s. 449.18.

surgery_prohibited.quote: Except as provided in par. (a), the practice of the profession of optometry does not include surgery or medical treatment.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: removing superficial foreign bodies from the eye or an appendage to the eye under s. 449.18.

value: Removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye or an appendage to the eye (not deeper than Bowman's layer of the cornea or deeper than the conjunctiva)
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: An optometrist who is allowed under sub. (1) to remove a foreign body from an eye or from an appendage to an eye may not remove a foreign body from an eye or from an appendage to an eye if the foreign body is deeper than Bowman's layer of the cornea or deeper than the conjunctiva.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Administering visual training, orthoptics, visual therapy or any other optometric means.

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: No optometrist may use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents or remove foreign bodies from an eye or from an appendage to the eye unless one of the following applies

value: Certificate to use topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (s. 449.17)
Certificate to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents and remove foreign bodies from an eye or appendage (s. 449.18)
specialty_certification_types.quote: The examining board shall certify an optometrist to use topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents if the optometrist was issued a license to practice optometry before August 1, 2006

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: optometrists who successfully complete 60 classroom hours of study in general and ocular pharmacology as it relates to optometry with particular emphasis on the use of topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents

referral_to_physician_required.quote: If, during the course of examining a person, an optometrist determines the existence of a pathological condition requiring treatment outside the scope of the practice of optometry, the optometrist shall so advise the person and shall refer the person to an appropriate health care professional

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: This section does not apply to a person who practices optometry under the supervision of an optometrist licensed under this chapter. The examining board shall promulgate rules specifying the conditions for supervision required under this subsection.

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: The examination shall also test knowledge of state laws and administrative rules regarding the practice of optometry.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: The person presents proof satisfactory to the examining board that, subject to ss. 111.321, 111.322, and 111.335, he or she does not have an arrest or conviction record.
